request:
Use case: identity-preserve. Create one finished full-body character illustration, not a reference sheet, board, collage, or explanatory graphic. The attached image is the sole identity and illustration-rendering reference for the canonical Legacy MALE lion. All five depicted views are the SAME ONE character; output exactly ONE character.

Requested change: put this exact character in a confident welcoming presentation pose: torso in three-quarter view, looking toward the viewer, his left hand resting naturally on his hip and his right arm extended to the side at lower-chest height with palm up, as if inviting someone into a room. Keep the same plain fitted black short-sleeve shirt, black trousers and black sneakers. No added accessories, text or logos.

Identity invariants: recognizable master face, broad pale muzzle with subtle whisker points, dark triangular nose, golden amber eyes beneath the same assertive eyebrows; layered swept-back golden-brown mane framing the face and tapering at the chest; adult heroic but master-matched athletic build, same head-to-body proportions and arm size, golden fur on exposed arms, one long golden tail with the same dark-gold tuft. Maintain the master’s semi-realistic illustrated mascot language: crisp confident contour lines, soft cel-shading, sculpted forms, controlled highlights. Do not inflate the muscles, turn him into a different generic lion, make him photorealistic or a plastic 3D toy.

Composition: one complete character head to feet, generous safe margins, 4:5 portrait. Both hands and both feet fully visible and anatomically coherent. Tail visible with a single continuous attachment. A clean warm-ivory studio backdrop like the reference, with a subtle contact shadow beneath his shoes. Neutral illumination allows direct identity comparison. Output the standalone finished image only.
preserve: Canonical male identity, outfit and rendering; welcoming gesture
scope_boundary: One principal character; bounded, explicitly requested changes.
